question: Do authenticated native EMC tumor-derived cultures retain donor-specific tumor transcriptional identity relative to unmatched native EMC tumors/cultures, beyond the known preservation of fusion labels and broad morphology?
useful_addition: A reproducible paired model-fidelity limit could identify whether culture-specific transcriptional measurements represent that donor tumor and which models/measurement contexts warrant testing. This is fidelity/association, not dependency, protein, therapeutic efficacy or a rescue of failed chemokine/IR/APA/static panels.
primary_prior_art: USZ22/23 establishment, identity and functional screen findings; Brenca native12/paired-frozen5 versus engineered11; Davila V1-34 accuracy sample; all12 TempO immune preparations and R8 culture-context status are reused. Culture context was pending, not biologically evaluated. Published preservation of morphology/fusion or known partner expression programs is not novel fidelity.
source_gate: Actual public same-donor native tumor-to-derived-culture case/model/libraries map, culture authentication, source preparation/capture/units, all paired/serial/repeat/control conditions, donor overlap and original claim. No new expression matrices, vectors or outcomes read until a useful source-supported contrast passes lead review.
eligibility: Explicit native EMC pathology/fusion eligibility labels and tissue-to-derived-culture provenance, not numeric aliases or tissue/line similarity
At least two independent paired native donor systems for a general fidelity claim; one pair may support a bounded descriptive source check only, not replicated EMC phenomenon
Comparable released measurement features and compatible normalization/capture or matched processing controls; every relevant eligible native pair and condition retained
Orthogonal tumor/culture identity/compartment or replicate controls capable of assessing mixture, sample preparation and culture handling, not mandatory new wet-lab work
prospective_measurement: If source gate survives, freeze exact common unambiguous feature eligibility/normalization before data, then compare paired tumor–culture distance/rank concordance with prespecified unmatched native donor comparisons and handling/platform controls. Gene expression amplitudes or housekeeping-dominated global correlations alone do not establish fidelity. No panel/gene set selected from favorable results. Numerical method requires dated source-specific amendment and lead approval.
strongest_alternatives: Loss of stromal/immune tissue fractions mimics malignant transcriptional drift
FFPE/frozen differences, RNA capture, platform mapping, depth and batch dominate paired distance
Passage/media/treatment/proliferation and histologic morphology differ from unlinked baseline tumor
Pair misassignment, donor reuse or technical wells/libraries counted as biological replication
Common housekeeping expression, fusion-partner prior art or unpaired cross-study culture/tumor comparisons mistaken for donor-specific model fidelity
defeat: No actual public paired same-donor native EMC conditions with meaningful controls and a useful unreported comparison => no numerical stage. Raw/processed data pending are not false exclusions for size, source absence or negative model biology. Known preservation alone cannot justify a paper.
all_conditions: All identifiable relevant native tumor/culture specimens, matched archived/frozen source materials, passages/treatments/replicates and control models, including unfavorable/unknown; explicit evaluated/reused/pending/unsuitable/unavailable disposition. Suitable pending sources block promotion.
own_exposure: Previously saw R8 fixed chemokine RNA/array outcomes and native model identity/count context, not a paired model-fidelity analysis. No new relevant tumor/culture outcome inspected; no chosen gene panel from those earlier results.
restrictions: Exact FAP-tissue/glycan/structural-genomics/HLA restrictions preserved; only fusion eligibility labels, no genomic mechanism expansion. No TMEM266 or shelved panels/IR/APA reanalysis. No unchanged failed route retries, private/login/bypass/spend/outreach/publication/PR/root mutations/push. Quiet metadata/files; clock before any image, none needed.

resources.reuse: No copies of existing matrices, count vectors, FASTQ/read streams; full originals ignored, compact relevant maps/scripts/receipts only.
